label: Halving a bracket
subgoals: Check the signs at the two endpoints
Keep the half with the sign change

visual.title: Each step halves the bracket
visual.caption: Bisection keeps a bracket whose endpoint values have opposite signs. It evaluates the midpoint and replaces the endpoint with the same sign, so the root stays inside and the interval halves each time.

predict.question: For x² − 2 on [0, 2], which half remains after the first bisection?
predict.explain: The midpoint is 1 and f(1) = −1. Since f(0) = −2 has the same sign, the left half is discarded. f(1) and f(2) = 2 have opposite signs, so the root stays in [1, 2].
